purpose: Four loading-screen design concepts; generated images copied unchanged

variants.name: 活力出击
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design one finished portrait mobile casual game loading screen for the Chinese game “泡泡小队”, aspect ratio 9:19.5, ideally 1080x2340. Full bleed artwork, no device mockup, no comparison board, no browser chrome. Strong polished professional mobile-game art direction and clear hierarchy. This game has cute plush animal heads growing out of soft felt flowerpots, with two green felt leaves under each head, blowing soap bubbles. Main mascot: bright cobalt blue fluffy bear, large round ears with cream interiors, big creamy double-lobed muzzle, small brown nose, slightly silly upturned eyes, sitting in a blue felt pot decorated with a pale cloud. The other mascots can include a lime-green round frog in a turquoise pot, a sleepy orange capybara in orange pot, a pink rabbit in pink pot, or a white kitten in lavender pot. Keep this recognizable world, but the loading page may have a different color palette from the gameplay. Top 8 percent is a quiet safe area. At roughly 84 percent height put a crisp readable loading text exactly “加载中… 36%” and a horizontal rounded progress bar filled to 36 percent, visibly separate from the main illustration; at 94 percent put small clean readable text “适度游戏，快乐生活”. No age-rating badge, no certification, no developer branding, no competitor logos or characters, no random labels, no extra UI buttons, no dense instruction text. Display the game title exactly “泡泡小队”, four Chinese characters, accurately, with distinctive well-designed typography. The result is a complete designed loading page, not a moodboard.
Direction A: VIBRANT ACTION. Sunlit tangerine orange and golden yellow field, vivid cobalt and mint accents. Bold diagonal composition with an arcing stream of luminous round soap bubbles leading the eye from the hero at lower-left / center toward a small curved cluster of colored pearl bubbles upper-right. An energetic very furry blue bear in its blue cloud flowerpot dominates the middle, blowing a bubble with funny determined cheeks, accompanied by one much smaller lime frog in its turquoise pot. NOT a shooter with weapons, no cannons, no cubes. Upper 18–32 percent has a large dynamic stacked 2-row “泡泡 / 小队” title, blue-white and creamy yellow thick playful molded letters with modest shadow. Main action occupies 38–72 percent. A few cropped foreground soap bubbles create depth, no busy scenery. Sunny high-energy 3D toy advertising with exceptionally tactile fur and felt pots, large smooth simple color fields. The loading bar is warm ivory with a cobalt/sky-blue fill and very shallow rounded bevel. Text dark navy. Crisp silhouette, bold color blocking, fun motion; avoid purple as the dominant background.

The blue fluffy bear in its blue felt cloud pot is the ONLY character and sits centered around 53 percent screen height, fully visible, occupying about 50 percent of the screen width and 30 percent height, tilting its gaze up toward one single large translucent soap bubble hovering just above its nose. Soft believable contact shadow, tactile fine plush fibers, cheerful tender expression. The top game title at 22 percent is one line, restrained rounded deep-teal lettering with a very thin white offset edge, not huge, never rainbow 3D lettering. Direction C: MINIMAL BOLD BRAND. Pure warm lemon-yellow background, deep cobalt blue and warm white as the only main accents. About 70 percent visual negative space. The whole hero is an exceptional custom Chinese logotype “泡泡小队” in two centered rows around 35–47 percent height: large chunky clean rounded cobalt typography with warm ivory inline counters and a slight playful bounce, flat graphic sticker aesthetic with one short offset shadow; perfectly readable. A tiny simplified blue fluffy bear head with cream muzzle peeks over the second “泡” character as an integrated logo detail, no full-body or flowerpot character scene. No 3D stage, no landscape, no crowd, no rainbow explosion, no glossy complicated panels. This version should look decisively simpler and more graphic than a plush 3D hero poster.

Direction D: CHEERFUL TEAM PORTRAIT. Warm coral pink background fading gently into creamy peach at the bottom, pale mint and apricot accent shapes. Soft storybook felt-collage illustration style, rounded friendly silhouettes with a subtle fuzzy flocked edge and stitched felt details; deliberately more graphic / illustrated than photoreal 3D. Five amusing plush flowerpot characters crowd together like a playful group photo in a triangular composition filling the middle 35–74 percent: blue bear largest near center-back, orange sleepy capybara on left, lime frog on right, smaller pink floppy rabbit and white kitten in front. Show their decorated small felt pots and leaves, endearing varied expressions, avoid generic bears without the muzzle and ears. Some characters lean into the frame, a few pastel soap bubbles float behind, a single broad understated pastel arch unifies them. A large simple cream-and-coral outlined “泡泡小队” title in one line at 18–27 percent, no competing slogans. Keep the lower loading region clean and unobstructed on a soft cream field: coral outlined white track with a muted teal fill, loading caption in dark plum. Fun companions and memorable faces, no complex gameplay board, no tiny clutter, no realistic environment.
